The change adds classic `mort` state-table dispatch and support for previously unsupported morph types. When the state array starts after the entry table, `stateDataLength` and `numStates` are negative, so the state-reading loop is skipped rather than raising; a rearrangement subtable can therefore return a table with no decoded states, satisfying the stated criterion even though it is not correctly decoded.
